correctness.rationale: The identity gcd(a-u,p^k)=1+sum_{j=1}^k phi(p^j) 1_{a=u mod p^j} gives mean k+1 for units. The centered matrix is M(sum_j P_j-kP_0) for nested orthogonal class-averaging projections. Its complete level-space spectrum is M(k-j+1), of dimensions phi(p^j)-phi(p^(j-1)); the covariance H^2/M has the announced spectrum. Entrywise shell formulas, the dyadic k=1 boundary, exact atom masses, rank and condition number follow algebraically. A separate pure-Python checker verifies 15 moduli, 315 independent level-difference vectors, and 16861 covariance entries from gcd arithmetic; no finite check is mistaken for a universal proof.

value.rationale: The unit-shifted Menon statistics are a standard arithmetic family for which a single mean is known but the joint covariance spectrum is a natural finer invariant. The theorem gives every eigenvalue, multiplicity, rank, sharp positive conditioning and a surprising geometric distribution on perfect squares with exact finite-depth total variation. It classifies an infinite two-parameter arithmetic Gram family, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a renamed first moment. General wavelet theory is background, and the specialist arithmetic interpretation remains useful even without a downstream theorem.
